description: This file defines a class FormatWithPurgeString that implements the ValueFormatter interface. The class provides a method getFormattedValue which returns a constant string 'Purged' regardless of the input. It appears to be used for formatting values in a maintenance purge strategy context within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeString
classes.description: Implements ValueFormatter to return a fixed string 'Purged' as formatted value.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the string 'Purged' regardless of input.
